blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GCash parent Mynt Inc. made its Philippine Stock Exchange debut on Tuesday, bringing the country’s largest e-wallet operator to the stock market following strong demand from local and foreign investors. The company marked its listing on the PSE’s main board with the opening bell. READ: All set for P92-B GCash IPO in Oct Its shares trade under the ticker symbol “GCASH,” following an initial public offering (IPO) priced at P6.60 apiece.
